What guides our Plan and Budget?
Our Plan and Budget (https://www.regionofwaterloo.ca/government-and-council/plans-budget-
and-performance/our-plan-and-budget/) is how we make wise investments in things that matter.
It’s how we support the people of Waterloo Region with:
     Roads and infrastructure
     Paramedic and public health services
     Clean drinking water and wastewater services
     Affordable housing
     Museums and cultural programming
     ...And much more!
Our focus for the 2027 budget is clear in the face of these pressures:
     affordability for residents,
     maintaining critical services, and
     protecting essential infrastructure.
This is a stability-focused budget to ensure that the services and systems our residents rely on remain
strong and reliable, while also supporting our community through a period of economic uncertainty.

Learn more about the Region!
  How does Regional Government work?                                                                 



          The region is a two-tier government consisting of the Region of Waterloo and 7 area
                                           municipalities.



                       There are 3 cities of Cambridge, Kitchener and Waterloo.

There are 4 townships of North Dumfries, Wellesley, Wilmot and Woolwich.



               There are 16 members of Regional Council, including the Regional Chair.
